ideas.pitch: A localized automated scanner specifically tuned to detect OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities and output proof-of-concept exploit scripts for CTF challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Web Security: Identify vulnerabilities and solve web-based security challenges.
ideas.title: DaemonInspect Web Vulnerability Automator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific Web Security track by combining automated scanning heuristics with code analysis, heavily decreasing solver time during a high-speed CTF event.

ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic puzzle solver leveraging frequency analysis, customized factorization scripts, and known-plaintext attack heuristics for CTF challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Cryptography: Decode encrypted messages and uncover hidden flags.
ideas.title: CryptAnalysis Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets cryptographic challenges by integrating automated solvers for classical ciphers and weak RSA implementations, letting single players bypass tedious manual decoding.

ideas.pitch: An automated memory dump and file metadata analyzer that extracts hidden strings, uncovers deleted fragments, and plots temporal event timelines for CTF forensic flags.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital Forensics: Investigate files, metadata, and digital evidence.
ideas.title: ForensicTimeline Investigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the Digital Forensics bottleneck by parsing deep file structures, exif data, and raw hex streams much faster than manual command-line inspection.

ideas.pitch: An open-source intelligence aggregation pipeline that crawls public metadata, username footprint registries, and geolocation artifacts to map hidden digital footprints.
ideas.problem_statement: OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence): Analyze publicly available information to uncover clues.
ideas.title: OSINT Graph Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes automated API scrapers and graph intelligence to correlate scattered online data points into clear visual connection paths for investigative flags.

ideas.pitch: An automated reverse-engineering helper that disassembles binaries, flags dangerous control flow patterns, and drafts human-readable pseudocode explanations.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse Engineering: Analyze programs and uncover their underlying logic.
ideas.title: BinaryBytecode Decompiler Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Speeds up the grueling manual process of analyzing compiled binaries and obfuscated code structures during tight individual CTF deadlines.
